what: A dispatched job's own prompt named a real file on disk that was never actually copied into its workspace, because nothing tracked, declared, or contextual named it either. The file existed, so a human reading the prompt assumed it would be there; the worker discovered only after starting that it was not, after real money had already been spent.
rule: A prompt naming a real, on-disk path that is covered by neither tracked files, declared context, nor an explicit declared resource is refused before dispatch, not discovered by the worker.
fix: Enforcement: a new manifest field lists extra files to copy into every job's own workspace; a missing declared file (or one that names a directory) refuses at validate time, and an un-declared path a prompt names that exists on disk is refused the same way. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs`.
